newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine to issue T-bills on October 15.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine to issue T-bills on October 15.

text.p: Ukraine's central bank will auction three-, six-, nine- and 12-month discount treasury bills on October 15, a central bank official said on Monday.
The volume of three-month T-bills was set at 20 million hryvnias, the head of the bank's market and exchange dapartment, Vitaly Migashko, told Reuters.
The central bank is not setting the issue volume of six-, nine- and 12-month T-bills in advance.

At the last auction of three-month discount T-bills on October 10, the bank sold 20 million hryvnias worth of paper, with an average annualised yield of 49.98 percent. The average price was 88.92 hryvnias.

At the last auction of six-month discount T-bills on October 10, the bank sold 15.67 million hryvnias worth of paper, with an average annualised yield of 59.53 percent. The average price was 77.11 hryvnias.
At the last auction of nine-month discount T-bills on October 8, the bank sold 5,000 hryvnias worth of paper, with an average annualised yield of 61.48 percent. The average price was 68.50 hryvnias.
At the last auction of 12-month discount T-bills on October 10, the bank sold 248,900 hryvnias worth of paper, with an average annualised yield of 61.46 percent. The average price was 62.00 hryvnias.
